author: SergeantSparkelz
body: I'm banned but it was a error! Can I please be unbanned?!
body_tagged: I'm banned but it was a error! Can I please be unbanned?!
title: Banned

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Your ban is not an error. You were banned on the SergeantSparkelz account because you were evading a ban you received on another account. Next time make sure you follow the appeal format, and I suggest you stop ban evading if you want this infraction to be appealed in the future.

Regards,
Mango_
